{{nihongo|'''Hioki Shrine'''|日置神社 (高島市)}} is a shrine in Sanami, Imazu-chō, {{ill|Takashima, Shiga|ar|تاكاشيما (شيغا)|azb|تاکاشیما، شیقا|ce|Такасима|ceb|Takashima|de|Takashima (Shiga)|eo|Takaŝima|es|Takashima (Shiga)|fa|تاکاشیما، شیگا|fi|Takashima|fr|Takashima|gl|Takashima|id|Takashima, Shiga|it|Takashima|ja|高島市|ko|다카시마시|mzn|تاکاشیما، شیگا|nl|Takashima|pl|Takashima|pt|Takashima (Shiga)|ro|Takashima, Shiga|ru|Такасима|sv|Takashima|tg|Такашима|th|ทากาชิมะ|tl|Takashima, Shiga|tr|Takashima|tt|Такасима|uk|Такасіма (Сіґа)|ur|ٹاکاشیما، شیگا|vi|Takashima, Shiga|war|Takashima, Shiga|zh|高島市|zh_classical|高島市|zh_min_nan|Takasima-chhī|zh_yue|高島|qid=Q845794}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|Q131358|qid=Q131358}}. It is a candidate {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} {{ill|Shikinai Ronsha|Q135022904|qid=Q135022904}}, and its {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=former shrine rank}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}. {{nihongo|'''Hioki Shrine'''|日置神社 (高島市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

== Shrine crest ==
* Sixteen-petal chrysanthemum

== History ==
In ancient times it was called Sanami Iwatsurugi Daibosatsu. It is the sōsha of Kawakami-go. == Shrine family ==
The priestly office has been inherited hereditarily by the Furumiya family.

== Festivals ==
* Annual festival (Kawakami Festival): April 18

== Cultural properties, etc. ==
* Five-ring stone pagoda - called the Regent Yorimichi Pagoda. Height: 8 shaku.
